program.section_heading: Media and Web Development - Non-Credit - COC
outcomes: Describe available development tools and other web development tools.
Describe the business functions of a website.
Plan, organize, and develop a basic multi-page business website.
Efficiently utilize web development tools to control formatting and layout of web pages and their content by adding text, graphics, media, widgets, navigation and links.
Demonstrate ability to publish and update site.
Understand the types of computer system concepts, terminology, and components and the impact they have on society.
Utilize logic skills and critical thinking while problem solving.

notes: The catalog labels the figures 'credits' / 'Credit Hours', but this is a noncredit Certificate of Completion, so they are recorded as hours. The figures read as hours: 36, 54 and 138-454.5.

The 'Requirements (Total 138 - 454.5)' heading total covers the whole program, including the nested Electives group. It is recorded as total_units, not as that block's stated total. The Requirements courses alone sum to 72-238.5 per the Recommended Sequence.
The 'Electives' group says 'Complete all of the following', so it is recorded with rule 'all' despite its name.
WORK0511 and OLAD0517 match the closed-list entries WORK 511 and OLAD 517 (the catalog prints the codes with a leading zero and no space).
CSCI0501 and OLAD0510 are not in the closed list and are marked as catalog additions.
The PSLOs are printed for the Non-Credit Certificate of Completion itself.

The description names 'entry-level Media and Web Development' and the 'computer systems design and related services industry' without naming specific careers or job titles; careers was left empty. A reviewer may wish to count these as career fields.
